gloss: somewhat thin; on the slim side; slender

definitions.gloss: somewhat thin; on the thin/slim side; slender
definitions.explanation: Indicates something or someone is a little thinner or slimmer than average. The め suffix softens the adjective, creating a moderate, approximate expression.

examples.japanese: {細|ほそ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細|ほそ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{好|す}みです。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細|ほそ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: She has a slim build, and any clothes look good on her.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix め to the adjective ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧. The め suffix creates a softer, approximate expression. Can describe objects (thin noodles, slim pens) and people's body types (slender).
